cases.note: A real, measured weakness, kept failing rather than explained away. Measured 2026-11-15T18:09Z on a requirement with six criteria covering the behaviour: the model returned one HIGH-severity suggestion, 'Missing criteria for address validation failure message', when criterion four already says a failed validation 'leaves the stored address unchanged and names the rejected field on screen'. It is a false positive at the highest severity, on the surface whose whole value is that a reviewer can trust what it flags. Note that this is a different failure from the one recorded before: until 69ef7b4 the same case died with invalid_output_quote_not_found, because an invented quote refused the entire review. That is fixed; what is left is the model inventing a problem, which is the thing the case is named for.
